tm_config.hardware: IMPACT in-memory inference on Y-Flash memristor crossbars (two-terminal Y-Flash, 180 nm CMOS, 3.159 um2/device). Clause crossbar tile 2048x500 in Boolean mode: TA include -> HCS ~2.5 uS (>2.4 uS), exclude -> LCS ~1 nS (programmed with 1 ms pulses, mean 7 pulses); literal '1' applied as floating Z, literal '0' as VR = 2 V; column current summed (Kirchhoff) into a latch current-sense amplifier (VDD 1.2 V, threshold 4.1 uA, 5 ns read: 2 ns delay + 2.5 ns SE + 500 ps discharge). Class crossbar tile 500x10 in analog tunable mode: signed weights shifted to unipolar 0-419 and mapped to uniform conductance segments over 1 nS-2.5 uS; pre-tune (500 us pulses, +-20 segments, <=10 pulses) then fine-tune (50 us pulses, +-5 segments, <=6 pulses); argmax over class currents. Trained in software (CoTM, 25 epochs), then mapped; CSA designed/simulated in Cadence (corner + 2000-sample Monte Carlo), Y-Flash variability from a compact model checked against a measured 12x8 (96-device) array. Energy/area numbers in Table 4 (energy per datapoint averaged over the 10,000 test images). Inference only.

notes: Hardware paper: the CoTM is trained in software (training script by a third person, acknowledgements p. 25) and only inference is mapped onto Y-Flash crossbars. MNIST is the only dataset with full mapping, tuning-pulse analysis and energy/area numbers; Table 5 lists 7 more datasets with classes/clauses/literals/accuracy only, no split, epochs, T, s or booleanization, and it does not say whether those accuracies are post-mapping. 'Human Activity' and 'Gesture Phase' are not further identified (record's dataset ids kept); modality/domain for EMG, Gesture Phase and Human Activity are dataset-level judgements, not from the paper. MNIST tile is 2048x500 but Table 4 sizes energy/area for 500x1568. The paper's include rule wording (p. 17) is garbled ('exceeds half of 128' vs '<= 128 exclude'); boundary 128 used. No run counts, seeds or selection protocol are stated anywhere. Table 6 baselines on CIFAR-10/100 ([27],[28],[30],[31]) are not in the record (as its extraction_notes say). Table 6 lists [27] as DNN while the text (p. 22) calls it BCNN on PCM; abstract says DNN-based PCM.
